scenarios.scenario-1: SNARC context reaches model input but is absent from persisted role=user message text.
scenarios.scenario-2: Transcript export or compaction capture containing `` fails verification.
scenarios.scenario-3: SNARC prompt capture stores the raw prompt, not the injected memory block.

evidence-types.evidence-1: Deterministic assertions inspect persisted session log and exported transcript bytes.
evidence-types.evidence-2: Trace assertions verify transient model input receives SNARC context.
evidence-types.evidence-3: Integration checks cover loop plus SNARC adapter behavior.

verification-levels.level-1: Run focused loop context isolation tests.
verification-levels.level-2: Run SNARC loop adapter and user persistence regression tests.
verification-levels.level-3: Run typecheck, MyGRACE lint, and full test suite before marking Phase-7 done.

telemetry-requirements.telemetry-1: Log whether memory context was injected without logging the memory payload.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-2: Expose warnings when SNARC context generation fails, but do not block the turn.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-3: Redact secrets before any trace or failure assertion stores prompt fragments.

autonomous-safety.safety-1: A model may execute this phase autonomously only after tests prove user transcript bytes stay raw.
autonomous-safety.safety-2: Any transcript pollution finding blocks Phase-7 completion.
